newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's weekly forex demand falls to $65.88 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's weekly forex demand falls to $65.88 mln.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Friday it sold $65.88 million at a rate of 85 to the dollar at its weekly auction this week.
Last week the bank sold $95.417 million at the rate of 80 naira to the dollar.
Bankers attributed the fall in demand this week to a 5.88 percent devaluation in the value of the naira announced by the central bank on Wedenesday which has made forex more expensive.
Demand for foreign exchange at the auction had risen steadily since mid-January when the government released its fiscal 1997 budget.
